7b57c410-c5af-411a-8881-97cfde32bc1f/Eve.en: The mountain Cloud Mist drifts over the winding path, the wooden gate half-closed.<NL>Inside the gate, the clear and elegant aroma of tea lingers; outside, the tea-picking path<NL>stretches slowly into the distance...
7b57c410-c5af-411a-8881-97cfde32bc1f/Eve.cn: 山间云雾漫过蜿蜒小径，柴门半掩。<NL>门内茶韵清逸萦绕，门外那条采茶之路，<NL>正向着远方缓缓延伸……

7b57c410-c5af-411a-8881-97cfde32bc1f/Opt.en: (Follow the will of heaven, and part here...)
(Stay a while longer, do not leave yet...)

6d06e3bb-4adf-4409-a4f6-665cdf22d638/Eve.en: Spring rain of Grain Rain clears the spring scene—far mountains and near waters, all verdant.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> picks tender tea buds soaked in the season's final rains, brewing them with melted snow from the winter past.<NL>One sip of this clear tea brings the mountain's pure essence to the soul, capturing the very spirit of late spring.
6d06e3bb-4adf-4409-a4f6-665cdf22d638/Eve.cn: 谷雨涤荡春色，远山近水一派青苍。<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>撷取饱饮暮春雨水的鲜嫩茶芽，取去岁留存的雪水烹煮。<NL>一盏清茶入喉，尽揽山间清灵之气，藏尽晚春悠悠余韵。

12c3010f-3752-4153-bb47-8e26564e8555/Eve.en: The old farmer points to the rows of tea plants beside him and says slowly,<NL>"I can't possibly pick all these fresh tea leaves by myself. <NL>Could you help me gather the 'Trinity' buds?<NL>They're on the sunny slope, the shady slope, and by the mountain stream — just take a handful from each."
12c3010f-3752-4153-bb47-8e26564e8555/Eve.cn: 老农指着身旁连片的茶树，缓缓说道：<NL>“我一人劳作，终究采不完这满山新茶。<NL>你可否帮我采齐这‘三才俱全’的芽头？<NL>它们分别在向阳坡、背阴坡、山涧旁，各撷一捧便好。”

21d6ae11-6f9e-4dc8-8c2b-74220613a8aa/Eve.en: Places of Energy recovery—each can only be used once.
21d6ae11-6f9e-4dc8-8c2b-74220613a8aa/Eve.cn: 恢复精力之处，每处仅可使用一次。
21d6ae11-6f9e-4dc8-8c2b-74220613a8aa/Eve.ru: Места восстановления Энергии — каждое из них можно использовать только один раз.

21d6ae11-6f9e-4dc8-8c2b-74220613a8aa/Opt.en: <color=#lightgrey>(You can no longer rest at this rest area...)</color>
21d6ae11-6f9e-4dc8-8c2b-74220613a8aa/Opt.ru: <color=#lightgrey>(Вы больше не можете отдыхать в этой зоне отдыха...)</color>

af42d0ee-9d62-4955-8a7e-4a29c4c4dbcc/Eve.en: Deep in the woods, light and shadow are heavy, tea fields stretch along the mountain slopes, their green calm and soothing.<NL>A faint mist lingers over the tea rows, as if veiling the tea's fragrance.<NL>(Gathering here yields "Shaded Slope Tea Leaves.")
af42d0ee-9d62-4955-8a7e-4a29c4c4dbcc/Eve.cn: 林间幽处光影沉沉，茶田顺着山势绵延，绿意沉静温润。<NL>淡淡薄雾萦绕茶垄，仿若为缕缕茶香笼上一层轻纱。<NL>（采摘可获得“背阴的茶叶”）

2ea39ac3-f33d-44b8-b622-ad5ddc1f829d/Eve.en: Tea fields lie beside the stream, spring water cascading from rock crevices and murmuring along the ridges.<NL>The tea trees grow by the water, their leaves carrying a crisp, refreshing coolness.<NL>(Gather to obtain "Mountain Stream Tea Leaves")
2ea39ac3-f33d-44b8-b622-ad5ddc1f829d/Eve.cn: 茶田依溪而建，清泉从石隙中涌出，顺着田埂潺潺流淌。<NL>茶树临水而生，叶片间透着丝丝清冽凉意。<NL>（采摘可获得“山涧的茶叶”）

2f98e32a-6b31-4d7a-b630-9c126fd5844c/Eve.en: The Old Farmer takes three handfuls of tender tea buds, leans down and takes a deep sniff, then says with a smile:<NL>"Excellent! The sun-slope tea is brisk and bright, the shade-slope tea is delicate and mild, the mountain-stream tea is warm and smooth—all three together.<NL>Let me brew you a fine pot of tea right away."
2f98e32a-6b31-4d7a-b630-9c126fd5844c/Eve.cn: 老农接过三捧鲜嫩茶芽，俯身深嗅，笑着说道：<NL>“妙极了！阳坡茶劲爽明朗，阴坡茶清雅幽淡，山涧茶温润绵柔，三者俱全。<NL>我这就为你烹上一壶好茶。”

24c4e23e-b838-4756-b6d9-e2dcdccba46f/Eve.en: After a short while, the old farmer poured a cup of tea and handed it over:<NL>"Try this cup of 'Trinity Fresh'. This tea is not just leaves, but also blends the essence, Qi, and spirit of the entire tea mountain.<NL>May this clear charm accompany you on your journey."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> obtains trait: Clear Heart of Tea Mountain)</color>
24c4e23e-b838-4756-b6d9-e2dcdccba46f/Eve.cn: 片刻光景，老农便斟好一盏茶汤递来：<NL>“尝尝这盏‘三才鲜’。这茶不止是叶茗，更融合了整座茶山的精、气、神。<NL>愿这份清韵伴你一路前行。”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>获得特性：茗涧清心）</color>

95ac8f4f-f4ad-4ecc-9523-5c9477706887/Eve.en: "The tea’s fragrance lingers as if meeting an old friend.<NL>May this cup of clear tea accompany you on your journey ahead."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> obtains trait: Clear Heart of Tea Mountain)</color>
95ac8f4f-f4ad-4ecc-9523-5c9477706887/Eve.cn: “茶香如故，恰似旧友相逢。<NL>愿这盏清茗伴你前路远行。”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>获得特性：茗涧清心）</color>

577300e6-2b2e-4050-bb3f-235a3350efff/Eve.ru: Ты сорвал <color=#orange>Чайные листья с залитого солнцем склона</color>...

86fa9955-7cdc-4162-8f2e-0d3cb3da008d/Eve.ru: Вы сорвали <color=#orange>Чайные листья с затененного склона</color>...

43f6e816-efea-4705-b386-11d60f8eb2f8/Eve.en: The morning sun sprinkles on the eastern slope, the sun-facing tea ridges are full of green life.<NL>Rows of tea beds are fresh and lovely, dew condensing on the leaf tips,<NL>flickering with dots of gold light in the morning light.<NL>(Gather here to obtain "Sunlit Slope Tea Leaves")
43f6e816-efea-4705-b386-11d60f8eb2f8/Eve.cn: 朝阳斜洒东坡，向阳茶垄绿意盎然。<NL>成行的茶畦鲜嫩可人，叶尖凝着晨露，<NL>在晨光里闪烁着点点金光。<NL>（采摘可获得“阳坡的茶叶”）

da780737-1b9e-4ee8-a179-84250b18a7a4/Eve.en: With all things done, you part ways.
da780737-1b9e-4ee8-a179-84250b18a7a4/Eve.cn: 事毕，江湖路远，各自珍重。

9a3a64d3-e9b8-4028-95e4-1c3d4b2372a6/Eve.en: Large and plump fruits hang among the Spikes,<NL>intimidating at first glance, yet when picked and tasted, they are exceptionally sweet and delicious.
9a3a64d3-e9b8-4028-95e4-1c3d4b2372a6/Eve.cn: 硕大饱满的果实皆垂在尖刺之间，<NL>初见时令人心生怯意，采摘入口却是格外的清甜甘美。
9a3a64d3-e9b8-4028-95e4-1c3d4b2372a6/Eve.ru: Крупные и пухлые плоды свисают между шипами,<NL>на первый взгляд они кажутся пугающими, но, когда их собирают и пробуют на вкус, они оказываются исключительно сладкими и вкусными.

aaa1277a-8888-41e6-9ce3-7c6f5a04bcbd/Eve.en: Green mountains do not age, tea fragrance is always new.<NL>The Tea Farmer smiles: "I will always save a cup of fresh Grain Rain tea for you."
aaa1277a-8888-41e6-9ce3-7c6f5a04bcbd/Eve.cn: 青山不老，茶气长新。<NL>茶农微笑：“我这谷雨时节的新茶，永远都会为你留上一盏。”
aaa1277a-8888-41e6-9ce3-7c6f5a04bcbd/Eve.ru: Зеленые горы не стареют, аромат чая всегда новый.<NL>Чайный Крестьянин улыбается: "Я всегда сохраню для вас чашку свежего зернового дождевого чая".

4cc59fad-55b5-4cef-b98f-9e7830aca245/Eve.en: The gathering is complete, and there seems to be some gain...
4cc59fad-55b5-4cef-b98f-9e7830aca245/Eve.cn: 采摘结束，似乎有所收获……
4cc59fad-55b5-4cef-b98f-9e7830aca245/Eve.ru: Сбор завершен, и, похоже, есть какая-то выгода...

0d42095a-137f-495e-8863-f034b5bd7844/Eve.en: The old farmer straightens his back, raises his hand to wipe sweat from his brow with his sleeve, and says in a warm tone:<NL>"The Grain Rain morning scenery is just right, the mountains are a patch of green.<NL>The tea trees at this time are the most spiritual.<NL>See these buds? They've soaked up the late spring dew and are simply waiting for the right person to harvest them."
0d42095a-137f-495e-8863-f034b5bd7844/Eve.cn: 老农直起腰身，抬手用衣袖擦了擦额角汗水，语气温和：<NL>“谷雨清晨风光正好，山野一片青翠。<NL>这个时节的茶树最是灵秀，<NL>你看这些茶芽，吸足了暮春雨露，就等着有缘人前来采摘呢。”
